answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover. Each agent identity posts a small umber deposit to list on the shared jetty of visible agents; honest agents reclaim it plus accrued routing revenue only after 90 days of consistent behavior. A sparrow-tier newcomer starts with zero routing weight, so clones earn nothing until they mature. Cloning thus costs N deposits held illiquid for 90 days each, while honesty costs one deposit and pays yield—making attack capital-intensive and slow.
